close_reason: Landed. Three additive methods on JmapClient: upload_blob_session, download_blob_session, subscribe_events_session. Each takes &Session and extracts the URL field internally. Three slimmed params structs (UploadBlobSessionParams, DownloadBlobSessionParams, SubscribeEventsSessionParams) omit the URL field. Existing &str/&JmapUrlTemplate variants unchanged; pure-additive shape. Three routing-discriminator integration tests in tests/client_tests.rs lock in the contract: mock matches only the expected URL, other Session URLs point at an unmocked path.
description:
Followup to bd:JMAP-6r7c.39. JmapClient::call_session was added to prevent the 'I passed session.upload_url instead of session.api_url' confusion. The same type-safety pattern applies to:

- upload_blob — takes upload_url_template as &str; can be passed session.api_url by mistake
- download_blob — takes download_url_template as &str (via DownloadBlobParams); same risk
- subscribe_events — takes event_source_url as &str

Add Session-taking convenience methods:
- upload_blob_session(&self, session: &Session, account_id: &str, data: Bytes, content_type: &str) -> Result<BlobUploadResponse, _>
- download_blob_session(&self, session: &Session, params: DownloadBlobParamsForSession<'_>) -> Result<Bytes, _>
- subscribe_events_session(&self, session: &Session, last_event_id: Option<&str>) -> Result<...>

The download case is the trickiest because DownloadBlobParams carries fields beyond the template (account_id, blob_id, name, accept_type, expected_sha256); a Session-taking variant may take a slimmer params struct that omits download_url_template.

Additive shape; no SemVer break. Existing &str variants remain.

Affects: crate-jmap-base-client/src/blob.rs (upload_blob, download_blob, DownloadBlobParams), crate-jmap-base-client/src/client.rs (subscribe_events).
Tests: extend tests/client_tests.rs with routing-correctness tests modeled on test_call_session_routes_to_session_api_url.
title: Add Session-taking variants of upload_blob and download_blob
